'''William Diniega EP1 LS senate''' is the [[Light]] constructed list [[William Diniega]] posted on DeckTech.<ref name="dt-19447">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19447 EP1 LS senate], DeckTech (William "FredDurst100" Diniega, 22 October 2001). Preservation copies: [https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/19447/ Stephen Skilton]; [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/19447/ GitHub Pages]; [https://web.archive.org/web/20261017003703/https://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/deck/19447/ Wayback Machine].</ref>

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[William Diniega]]
* '''Published:''' 22 October 2001 (DeckTech)
* '''Published title:''' ''EP1 LS senate''
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Plead My Case To The Senate / Sanity And Compassion|Cor-L-pleadmycasetothesenate.gif|label=Plead My Case To The Senate}}
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Mindful Of The Future|Cor-L-mindfulofthefuture.gif}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|A Tragedy Has Occurred|Cor-L-atragedyhasoccurred.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor Senate Diniega LS 2001 DeckTech.txt |Download]] (omits Coruscant (Light) (Coruscant), Tatooine (Light) (Coruscant), Control (Coruscant), Alter (Light) (Coruscant), Sense (Light) (Coruscant): no GEMP blueprint)
* '''Strategy:''' senate deck that works.

== Original post ==

'''EP1 LS senate'''
* '''Author:''' William "FredDurst100" Diniega
* '''Published:''' October 22, 2001
* '''Rating:''' 2.5
* '''Description:''' senate deck that works.

=== Strategy ===

This deck will probably get wooped by wattos box, but it has heavy force damage and retrieval, something you dont see much of in type 2.
